text.title: Feature Prioritisation — RICE Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply Feature Prioritisation — RICE end-to-end. Each step names its input, action, and output. Then the six-step scoring process with sanity check and strategic override lane.

step.name: collect-items
step.action: List candidate features; cap at 20 for one batch.

step.name: score
step.action: Per item, estimate Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort.

step.name: rank
step.action: Sort descending; flag confidence-floor / effort-ceiling violations.

step.name: record
step.action: Capture top-N as decision record with rationale.

section.title: Scoring process

step.name: score-factors
step.input: Candidate list + scales in 01-core-rules.xml (rules r7-impact-fixed-scale, r8-confidence-cap-without-evidence, r9-effort-breakdown-required)
step.action: Step 2: Score each factor per item with rationale
step.output: Factor scores with rationale per item

step.name: calculate
step.action: Step 3: Calculate RICE = (R x I x C) / E

step.name: sanity-check
step.action: Step 5: Sanity-check: any item with score > 2x the median requires human review before entering "Now"

step.name: strategic-override
step.action: Step 6: Apply strategic override lane for top-2 bets to prevent crowding by easy wins
step.output: Final ranking with override lane; re-scored quarterly per rule r10-rescore-quarterly

section.reference: Multi-feature scoring table with R/I/C/E columns, RICE score, rank, and notes.
Single-feature record: factor scores with rationale, calculation, rank, decision.
Minimal scorer: reads JSON with reach/impact/confidence/effort, returns ranked output.
